newsitem.title: DENMARK: DANISH SHARES DIP ON PROFIT-TAKING, LEVELS TO HOLD.
newsitem.headline: DANISH SHARES DIP ON PROFIT-TAKING, LEVELS TO HOLD.

text.p: Danish share prices closed lower on Tuesday, hit by profit-taking, with dealers seeing levels holding or slight gains ahead but the trend unchanged.

"Prices have fallen back and it looks like we are entering a period of profit-taking. The strong dollar is having a positive effect on export industries though, so rises cannot be ruled out," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index lost 2.14 point to close at 188.46 in overall bourse turnover of 1.138 billion crowns. The KFX August future fell 0.33 point to 188.65 with 394 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
